name: ResultTable
description:
A table result: the first rows inline in the AI table style, columns stepping away by
priority as the card narrows, and rows becoming a compact list in very narrow cards.
"Show all 1,284" opens the full DataTable in a window.

props.name: result
props.type: ResultBase & { type: "table"; columns: ResultColumn[]; rows: ResultRow[]; total: number; noun?: Partial<Record<Intl.LDMLPluralRule, string>> & { other: string; }; }
props.description: The table result: `columns`, `rows` (the first 8 show inline), `total` for the count and Show all, and an optional row `noun`.
